local_services: run-owned temporary ComfyUI using the existing aki-v2 target read-only

target_roots.runtime_base: run-owned temporary directory outside the repository and target roots

required_preconditions: executed candidate equals candidate_sha and executed harness blob/file SHA-256 equals harness_sha256
the aki-v2 main.py and python.exe paths exist and normalize exactly to the authorized targets
the fresh live-03 evidence destination is absent and is atomically reserved before external actions
the authorized image SHA-256 matches before copying it into the run-owned input root
Windows-native and WSL GPU samples agree within 128 MiB and used memory is <=4096 MiB before service start
no target ComfyUI/Ollama process and no listener on 8191/11434 before service start
OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD is observed true and the owned Ollama PID has no non-loopback connection for at least 10 seconds and at least 5 samples
the exact local model gemma4:26b exists without download
all required workflow class_type values are present in the live target registry before the effective image attempt
required_checks: drive the real image through public Comfy /prompt and /history using LVWControlledImageInput and LVWImagePromptBridge
validate the real lvw.prompt/1 domains.observation and text_en semantic Oracle
prove distinct raw_response and suggestion, no automatic draft write, and explicit adopt draft_epoch increment through public state nodes
exercise the manual CPU public route after owned Ollama stop
write a parseable redacted run-summary and SHA-256 artifact manifest from structured values
prove per-call unload, terminal /api/ps empty, owned-only process cleanup, empty target ports, removed run temp and unchanged target fingerprints
leave all fixed product cases NOT_RUN pending independent WP-S1-04 review
mandatory_stops: candidate, harness, target path, model, sample, run ID or evidence destination mismatch
pre-service identity, GPU, process or port gate failure
no-cloud or non-loopback network gate failure
GPU memory reaches or exceeds 23552 MiB
public /prompt, /history, registry, semantic Oracle or state-isolation failure
model call, effective image attempt or public API submission budget would be exceeded
listener ownership cannot be re-proven immediately before termination
terminal evidence serialization or write failure
per-call unload, final cleanup, target integrity or privacy minimization gap
forbidden: downloads, upgrades or permanent target configuration writes
termination of non-owned or no-longer-proven processes
product contract, fixed denominator, owner, Oracle, timeout or threshold changes
use of any media other than the single hash-bound image
reuse of live-01 or live-02 evidence, AUTH-V0-S1-2026-10-28-01, or AUTH-V0-S1-2026-10-28-02
evidence_minimization: persist aliases, hashes, aggregate counts, authorized listener owner IDs and redacted diagnostics only; never persist private absolute sample paths, unrelated process tables, unrelated command lines or original media bytes
cleanup: unload every started model call, require terminal /api/ps empty, re-prove listener ownership before each termination, stop run-owned PIDs, prove ports empty, remove run-owned base/input/output/temp, and prove aki-v2 target fingerprints unchanged
expires_when: one terminal WP-S1-03 live-03 receipt is generated, the single effective image attempt is consumed, or any mandatory stop occurs
